name: chakkiyar102/claude-video-engine
description: A bundled video-pipeline plugin skill. Intake copies the user's raw clip into a job, engine commands run via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, and jobs are stored in the current project, producing captioned video through a pipeline CLI.
install: git clone plus python3 -m pip install openai-whisper pillow, with FFmpeg installed separately through the operating system package manager
